testcase.name: likelihood = exposure + vulnerability - 1, only for valid scales
default security matrix is complete and monotonic, but not approved
risk and residual risk are computed from the matrix; only accepted countermeasures count
impact floor follows the worst linked safety severity (proposal)
derive: one threat per deliberate cause of an accepted hazard, no duplicates
completeness: rationale, hazard link, high risk needs countermeasure, countermeasure needs requirement
level 2 report: matrix, threat log, trace; XLSX sheet
